title: thelypteris nemoralis
intro: Thelypteris nemoralis, commonly known as the Wood Fern or Lemon Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated skin. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris nemoralis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
